idea.angle: Stop manually copying data between local spreadsheets and web portals; Gemini can now interact directly with your desktop apps.

piece.caption: How to automate desktop tasks and data entry using Google Gemini computer use. Google has started rolling out a new computer use feature in its Gemini macOS app. It can handle multi-step tasks across desktop applications, local files, and browsers like filling forms or creating listings. You control which apps Gemini accesses, and a live preview window lets you watch it run. Right now, it is available in English for US macOS users. To get your local spreadsheets and invoice folders ready for desktop AI agents when they launch in India, structure your local files cleanly today. Comment SETUP for our local file setup guide.

claims.claim: Google Gemini app for macOS introduced a computer use feature to perform multi-step tasks across local files, desktop apps, and the web.
Gemini can help speed up workflows, fill in forms, make presentations, and list items for sale.
Users can specify which desktop applications Gemini can access.
Gemini shows a live preview in a background chat window while performing desktop tasks.
The computer use feature is currently rolling out in English for users in the US on macOS.

piece.dm_text:
Here is how to prepare your business files before desktop AI agents launch in India:

1. Standardize file naming (e.g., Supplier_Invoice_Date.xlsx).
2. Keep local desktop folders organized by department or client.
3. Gemini app for macOS now features computer use for local files, desktop apps, and web tasks.
4. You will be able to select exact app permissions and view a live background preview window.
5. Feature is currently rolling out in English for US users on macOS.

visual_issues: Scene 5: Using green checkmarks for 'US English Mac Only' inside a checklist along with actionable steps visually mixes up a technical limitation with a setup task.
issues: The hook refers generically to 'PC', but the feature is strictly rolling out on macOS. Indian SMB owners often associate 'PC' exclusively with Windows machines.
review.fix_instructions: In Scene 1 narration, specify 'Mac par Excel...' or clarify early that this feature is currently on macOS to avoid misleading Windows PC users. In Scene 5 visual, split the limitation ('US Mac Only') into a header note rather than combining it into a checkmark list with action steps.

Jay Peters Nov 19, 2026, 6:21 PM UTC Link
Jay Peters is a senior reporter covering technology, gaming, and more. He joined The Verge in 2019 after nearly two years at Techmeme. Google’s Gemini app for macOS now has computer use, meaning it can help you “get multi-step tasks done across your local files, desktop apps, and the web,” the company says . Google suggests the feature might be useful for things like speeding up workflows, filling in forms, making presentations, and listing items for sale.
Users will be able to decide which of your apps Gemini can access, and be able to follow along as Gemini works because it has its own background window that shows a live preview in your chat, Google says. The feature is rolling out now in English for users in the US.
Gemini is introducing the new feature ahead of Apple launching new restrictions for apps wanting “full disk access” on Mac due to potential risks from AI agents with computer use. A preview of the settings rolled out with this week’s macOS 27.3 beta .
